SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow managed apparel
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow apparel selected by Work or Non-Work rules, retained locker stock and individual saved or borrowed garments. Remove or Clear keeps a type managed; use Forget in Choose apparel to release unused stock.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow non-managed apparel
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow ordinary apparel outside AOM selections, retained stock and individual saved or borrowed garments.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow managed weapons
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow weapons selected by Work or Non-Work rules, retained locker stock and individual saved or borrowed weapons. Remove or Clear keeps a type managed; use Forget in Choose weapons to release unused stock.

SpecialThingFilterDef.label: allow non-managed weapons
SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Allow ordinary weapons outside AOM selections, retained stock and individual saved or borrowed weapons.
